historical_result.exact_error: Locator.evaluate: Timeout 60000ms exceeded while waiting for locator("select[name=\"region_id\"]:visible").first
historical_result.upstream_observation: Snapshots immediately after both account-navigation clicks returned execution-context-destroyed errors, although both subsequent address fills reported success. The failure screenshot showed the address form and California region control near the bottom of the viewport; no DOM geometry or page error was retained.

unsaved_california_variant.name: California
unsaved_california_variant.qualification: diagnostic only: the region was changed in the unsaved form before the frozen fill/select prefix, not restored as a full site state

site_control_semantics.source_behavior: The Magento address template renders both select[name=region_id] and input[name=region]. The region updater shows one and hides the other depending on available region data. Text reading California in the historical failure screenshot cannot establish that the required select was visible or had nonzero geometry.
site_control_semantics.environment_control_reset_scope: Shopping environment-control init changes the Magento base URL and flushes cache; restart stops and starts services. Neither operation restores the address database. A component writable-layer replacement would be needed for a true fixture reset.

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 历史第 8 步等待可见的州下拉框超时；Magento 页面同时有州下拉框和文本框，旧截图中的 California 不能证明下拉框可见。旧轨迹未留 DOM 几何及州控件初始化状态，无法把这次超时归因于 Moli 布局或网站脚本。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The historical action 8 timed out waiting for a visible region select. Magento renders both a select and a text input, so California in the old screenshot does not prove the select was visible. The old trace retained neither DOM geometry nor region-updater state, preventing attribution to Moli layout or site script.
excluded_hypotheses: A deterministic Moli 1.1.3 failure to select this frozen selector at the historical viewport is contradicted by a same-image current-site success.
The selected California value alone does not reproduce the timeout; the unsaved California variant also succeeded.
reviewed_cause.remaining_evidence_gap: Historical live DOM geometry, page errors, region-updater state, and exact pre-task site state were not retained. The screenshot alone cannot distinguish a hidden select with a visible text input from a visible select whose geometry was misreported, so navigation timing, site-script readiness, browser layout, and site-state interference remain separable only in a new instrumented reproduction.
reviewed_cause.remediation: Preserve the original score and its action-8 locator error. Do not attribute the later qualified pass to a specific Moli code change without a state-matched reproduction or stronger contemporaneous trace.
